MACHINE AirportBaggageInteractionMachine_1
SEES AirportBaggageContext
VARIABLES
    sentMessages, sender, receiver, receivedMessages, senderdataMessages, currentMessage, receiverdataMessages, bagCleared, t_time_1, t_delay_1, t_success_1, t_time_2, t_delay_2, t_success_2, t_time_4, t_delay_4, t_success_4
INVARIANTS
    inv1: sentMessages ⊆ Messages
    inv2: currentMessage ⊆ Messages
    inv3: sender ⊆ Messages × Objects
    inv4: receiver ⊆ Messages × Objects
    inv5: receivedMessages ⊆ sentMessages
    inv6: senderdataMessages ⊆ Messages × DataMessages
    inv7: receiverdataMessages ⊆ Messages × DataMessages
    inv8: bagCleared ∈ ℤ
    inv9: t_time_1 ∈ ℤ
    inv10: t_delay_1 ∈ ℤ
    inv11: t_success_1 ∈ ℤ
    inv12: t_time_2 ∈ ℤ
    inv13: t_delay_2 ∈ ℤ
    inv14: t_success_2 ∈ ℤ
    inv15: t_time_4 ∈ ℤ
    inv16: t_delay_4 ∈ ℤ
    inv17: t_success_4 ∈ ℤ
EVENTS
    INITIALISATION BEGIN
        act1: sentMessages := ∅
        act2: sender := ∅
        act3: receiver := ∅
        act4: receivedMessages := ∅
        act5: senderdataMessages := ∅
        act6: receiverdataMessages := ∅
        act7: currentMessage := ∅
        act8: bagCleared := 0
        act9: t_time_1 :∈ 0..3
        act10: t_delay_1 := 0
        act11: t_success_1 := 0
        act12: t_time_2 :∈ 0..20
        act13: t_delay_2 := 5
        act14: t_success_2 := 0
        act15: t_time_4 :∈ 15..13
        act16: t_delay_4 := 0
        act17: t_success_4 := 0
    END


    sendtagBag_1
    WHEN
        grd1: tagBag_1 ∉ sentMessages
        grd2: currentMessage = ∅
    THEN
        act1: sentMessages := sentMessages ∪ {tagBag_1}
        act2: sender := sender ∪ {tagBag_1 ↦ CheckInDesk}
        act3: receiver := receiver ∪ {tagBag_1 ↦ BaggageSystem}
        act4: receivedMessages := ∅
        act5: senderdataMessages := senderdataMessages ∪ {tagBag_1 ↦ bagTag}
        act6: currentMessage := {tagBag_1}
    END

    receivetagBag_1
    WHEN
        grd1: tagBag_1 ∈ sentMessages
        grd2: tagBag_1 ↦ CheckInDesk ∈ sender
        grd3: tagBag_1 ↦ BaggageSystem ∈ receiver
        grd4: tagBag_1 ∉ receivedMessages
        grd5: currentMessage = {tagBag_1}
    THEN
        act1: receivedMessages := receivedMessages ∪ {tagBag_1}
        act2: receiverdataMessages := receiverdataMessages ∪ {tagBag_1 ↦ bagTag}
        act3: currentMessage := ∅
        act4: t_success_1 := t_time_1 + t_delay_1
    END

    sendrouteBag_2
    WHEN
        grd1: routeBag_2 ∉ sentMessages
        grd2: currentMessage = ∅
        grd3: tagBag_1 ∈ receivedMessages
    THEN
        act1: sentMessages := sentMessages ∪ {routeBag_2}
        act2: sender := sender ∪ {routeBag_2 ↦ BaggageSystem}
        act3: receiver := receiver ∪ {routeBag_2 ↦ BagSorter}
        act4: receivedMessages := ∅
        act5: senderdataMessages := senderdataMessages ∪ {routeBag_2 ↦ bagTag, routeBag_2 ↦ gateNo}
        act6: currentMessage := {routeBag_2}
    END

    receiverouteBag_2
    WHEN
        grd1: routeBag_2 ∈ sentMessages
        grd2: routeBag_2 ↦ BaggageSystem ∈ sender
        grd3: routeBag_2 ↦ BagSorter ∈ receiver
        grd4: routeBag_2 ∉ receivedMessages
        grd5: currentMessage = {routeBag_2}
    THEN
        act1: receivedMessages := receivedMessages ∪ {routeBag_2}
        act2: receiverdataMessages := receiverdataMessages ∪ {routeBag_2 ↦ bagTag, routeBag_2 ↦ gateNo}
        act3: currentMessage := ∅
        act4: t_success_2 := t_time_2 + t_delay_2
    END

    sendsorted_3
    WHEN
        grd1: sorted_3 ∉ sentMessages
        grd2: currentMessage = ∅
        grd3: routeBag_2 ∈ receivedMessages
    THEN
        act1: sentMessages := sentMessages ∪ {sorted_3}
        act2: sender := sender ∪ {sorted_3 ↦ BagSorter}
        act3: receiver := receiver ∪ {sorted_3 ↦ BaggageSystem}
        act4: receivedMessages := ∅
        act5: currentMessage := {sorted_3}
    END

    receivesorted_3
    WHEN
        grd1: sorted_3 ∈ sentMessages
        grd2: sorted_3 ↦ BagSorter ∈ sender
        grd3: sorted_3 ↦ BaggageSystem ∈ receiver
        grd4: sorted_3 ∉ receivedMessages
        grd5: currentMessage = {sorted_3}
    THEN
        act1: receivedMessages := receivedMessages ∪ {sorted_3}
        act2: currentMessage := ∅
    END

    sendloadBag_4
    WHEN
        grd1: loadBag_4 ∉ sentMessages
        grd2: currentMessage = ∅
        grd3: sorted_3 ∈ receivedMessages
        grd4: bagCleared = 1
    THEN
        act1: sentMessages := sentMessages ∪ {loadBag_4}
        act2: sender := sender ∪ {loadBag_4 ↦ BagSorter}
        act3: receiver := receiver ∪ {loadBag_4 ↦ Aircraft}
        act4: receivedMessages := ∅
        act5: senderdataMessages := senderdataMessages ∪ {loadBag_4 ↦ bagTag}
        act6: currentMessage := {loadBag_4}
    END

    receiveloadBag_4
    WHEN
        grd1: loadBag_4 ∈ sentMessages
        grd2: loadBag_4 ↦ BagSorter ∈ sender
        grd3: loadBag_4 ↦ Aircraft ∈ receiver
        grd4: loadBag_4 ∉ receivedMessages
        grd5: currentMessage = {loadBag_4}
        grd6: bagCleared = 1
    THEN
        act1: receivedMessages := receivedMessages ∪ {loadBag_4}
        act2: receiverdataMessages := receiverdataMessages ∪ {loadBag_4 ↦ bagTag}
        act3: currentMessage := ∅
        act4: t_success_4 := t_time_4 + t_delay_4
    END

    sendloadedAck_5
    WHEN
        grd1: loadedAck_5 ∉ sentMessages
        grd2: currentMessage = ∅
        grd3: loadBag_4 ∈ receivedMessages
        grd4: bagCleared = 1
    THEN
        act1: sentMessages := sentMessages ∪ {loadedAck_5}
        act2: sender := sender ∪ {loadedAck_5 ↦ Aircraft}
        act3: receiver := receiver ∪ {loadedAck_5 ↦ BaggageSystem}
        act4: receivedMessages := ∅
        act5: currentMessage := {loadedAck_5}
    END

    receiveloadedAck_5
    WHEN
        grd1: loadedAck_5 ∈ sentMessages
        grd2: loadedAck_5 ↦ Aircraft ∈ sender
        grd3: loadedAck_5 ↦ BaggageSystem ∈ receiver
        grd4: loadedAck_5 ∉ receivedMessages
        grd5: currentMessage = {loadedAck_5}
        grd6: bagCleared = 1
    THEN
        act1: receivedMessages := receivedMessages ∪ {loadedAck_5}
        act2: currentMessage := ∅
    END

    senddivertBag_6
    WHEN
        grd1: divertBag_6 ∉ sentMessages
        grd2: currentMessage = ∅
        grd3: sorted_3 ∈ receivedMessages
        grd4: bagCleared = 0
    THEN
        act1: sentMessages := sentMessages ∪ {divertBag_6}
        act2: sender := sender ∪ {divertBag_6 ↦ BagSorter}
        act3: receiver := receiver ∪ {divertBag_6 ↦ CheckInDesk}
        act4: receivedMessages := ∅
        act5: senderdataMessages := senderdataMessages ∪ {divertBag_6 ↦ bagTag}
        act6: currentMessage := {divertBag_6}
    END

    receivedivertBag_6
    WHEN
        grd1: divertBag_6 ∈ sentMessages
        grd2: divertBag_6 ↦ BagSorter ∈ sender
        grd3: divertBag_6 ↦ CheckInDesk ∈ receiver
        grd4: divertBag_6 ∉ receivedMessages
        grd5: currentMessage = {divertBag_6}
        grd6: bagCleared = 0
    THEN
        act1: receivedMessages := receivedMessages ∪ {divertBag_6}
        act2: receiverdataMessages := receiverdataMessages ∪ {divertBag_6 ↦ bagTag}
        act3: currentMessage := ∅
    END

    sendmanifestUpdate_7
    WHEN
        grd1: manifestUpdate_7 ∉ sentMessages
        grd2: currentMessage = ∅
        grd3: loadedAck_5 ∈ receivedMessages ∨ divertBag_6 ∈ receivedMessages
    THEN
        act1: sentMessages := sentMessages ∪ {manifestUpdate_7}
        act2: sender := sender ∪ {manifestUpdate_7 ↦ BaggageSystem}
        act3: receiver := receiver ∪ {manifestUpdate_7 ↦ Aircraft}
        act4: receivedMessages := ∅
        act5: senderdataMessages := senderdataMessages ∪ {manifestUpdate_7 ↦ flightNo}
        act6: currentMessage := {manifestUpdate_7}
    END

    receivemanifestUpdate_7
    WHEN
        grd1: manifestUpdate_7 ∈ sentMessages
        grd2: manifestUpdate_7 ↦ BaggageSystem ∈ sender
        grd3: manifestUpdate_7 ↦ Aircraft ∈ receiver
        grd4: manifestUpdate_7 ∉ receivedMessages
        grd5: currentMessage = {manifestUpdate_7}
    THEN
        act1: receivedMessages := receivedMessages ∪ {manifestUpdate_7}
        act2: receiverdataMessages := receiverdataMessages ∪ {manifestUpdate_7 ↦ flightNo}
        act3: currentMessage := ∅
    END

END
